newsitem.title: USA: Hilton sees ITT deal as accretive - CNBC.
newsitem.headline: Hilton sees ITT deal as accretive - CNBC.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp chief executive officer Stephen Bollenbach said he believes Hilton's proposed acquisition of ITT Corp will add to Hilton's earnings, despite debt assumption of about $4.0 billion.
"We are confident the deal will be accretive," Bollenbach said in an interview on cable television channel CNBC on Monday.
He also said Hilton first approached ITT about a merger last fall, but at the time ITT executives expressed no interest in the deal.
Also, Bollenbach said he had spoken with some ITT institutional stockholders and they were not hostile to the takeover bid. But he had not spoken directly with ITT's chairman Rand Araskog today.
Lastly, he called Hilton's bid for ITT "a very strong offer," but in a statement issued earlier, Hilton said it might consider raising the bid after a full review of ITT's books.
